## EcclesiaOS v1.0.65

### Website Studio presentation fixes

- Removed gradient and shadow effects from public website buttons, including their hover state.
- Changed the column “Full width” option to a true full-screen, edge-to-edge layout.
- Removed enclosing borders, margins, padding, and corner radius from full-screen columns.
- Renamed the editor option to “Full screen (edge to edge)” to make its behavior clear.

### Verification

- The Website Studio feature suite passes with 12 tests and 390 assertions.
- Composer validation, the production frontend build, and Git whitespace checks pass.
- No database migration is required.
